event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Semis bounced, but it's an oversold snap, not a turn. ISM Manufacturing printed 55.5 vs 54.6 fc and September factory orders 1.8% vs 1.2% fc, yet SPY managed only +0.30% and DIA fell 0.44% — real money sold SPY (-$6.65bn, 15th pctile) into strength while buying SOXX (+$1.30bn, 98p) and IJR (+$575mm, 100p). Rate path is the trapdoor: CME FedWatch prices a December 9 hike at 100%.

INDICES — VIX 20.8, above its 17.6 20-day MA. SOXX +2.50%, QQQ +0.62%, SPY +0.30%, IWM +0.23%, DIA -0.44%. Large > small by 0.39pp. Bonds were the quiet tell: TLT -0.76%, SLV -1.60%.

VOLUME & BREADTH — Accumulation only in mid-caps and semis (IJH 1.5x, SOXX 1.3x, RSP 1.2x); SPY 0.8x and IWM 0.7x means the headline tape is being ignored. SPY: price up on falling volume = low-conviction. QQQ vol_ratio not in the dataset, so treat the QQQ move as unconfirmed. Breadth diverges: 38% advancers, %>50DMA 65, up/down volume 0.94, 23 highs vs 11 lows — 189 up against 313 down. Narrow rally: False, but the price/flow split says otherwise.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLK Technology +1.31%, XLI Industrials +0.95%, XLRE Real Estate +0.07%, XLC Comms +0.00%, XLB Materials +0.00%, XLV Healthcare -0.31%, XLU Utilities -0.57%, XLF Financials -0.64%, XLY Discretionary -0.70%, XLE Energy -0.85%, XLP Staples -2.07%. MSOS +6.90% and TAN +3.02% topped industries; GDX -1.96% and XRT -1.92% lagged. Flows went to XLF +$1.29bn (98p), XLV +$640mm (94p) and XLI +$529mm (85p) while XLP bled -$502mm (10p) — flows contradict the price ranking, with financials bought and sold hardest on tape. Money-in: financials, healthcare, industrials. Money-out: staples, utilities. Label: narrow mega-cap tape.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 0.64 says complacency, while QQQ 1.18 says protection is being bought where the damage is. Skew is positive across the board (SPY +11.5%, QQQ +9.1%), so puts carry real premium. VIXEQ 42.8 vs VIX 20.8 is a 22-point gap — extreme single-stock dispersion, an implied-correlation collapse: rotation tape, not macro tape. GEX flip unavailable.

CROSS-ASSET — Gold -0.66% and silver -1.60% with real yields up (TLT -0.76%) — metals pricing the hike odds, not risk appetite. Crude +0.83% on API -5.27mm barrels vs +1.99mm fc, with EIA inventory tomorrow at 1.99mm fc. Next FOMC December 9: FedWatch hold 0.0%, cut 0.0%, hike 100.0%; Polymarket has 74% YES on a 2026 hike and 22% YES on no change, down 4pp in five days.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 53.3, neutral. Movers: ETN +7.00%, GEV +6.49%, ORCL +5.85% on the $20bn common stock and senior note pricing. Vol spikes: ORCL 2.5x with price up = accumulation; TAN 3.5x at +3.02% = accumulation, PLTR 2.2x at -1.65% = distribution. Momentum: XLK worst 20-day at -12.62% against XLRE +6.25% best. Watch TAN (3.5x volume, +3.02%), ORCL (2.5x, dilution priced as strength) and SOXX (-21.11% over 20 days, +2.50% today — bounce or dead-cat).
